title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: Players lead warm-ups
hook: What happens when a player leads warm-ups?
statement: Leading in front of peers builds a different kind of confidence.
q1: Do you let a different player lead each week —
q2: or keep warm-ups coach-led so they stay on track?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids grow
t2: when they get to lead their teammates.
ctaPrompt: Share your warm-up habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What happens when a player leads warm-ups?
You always lead the warm-up. Kids follow along without thinking.
Leading in front of peers builds a different kind of confidence.
Players lead or the coach leads. Both can work.
Who leads warm-ups? Share your habit in the comments.
